description: Get the live x402 reliability numbers from our own paid tests over the last 30 days: how many endpoints delivered once paid, how often payments didn't go through, how many bad calls still charged the buyer and how many were refunded, why paid calls fail, what calls cost, and the sellers that refund failed calls. Includes the same numbers from about 30 days earlier when available. Use it to answer questions about x402 reliability as a whole or which sellers refund; for one endpoint use check_endpoint, for one seller seller_endpoints. Read-only and free; recomputed every 6 hours. The same data is at lumierepaycheck.org/reliability.

refunders.description: How many sellers that refund to list, most refunds first (default 10)

name: reliability_report

deliveredPct.description: Share of endpoints whose latest graded paid test delivered

forTeams.description: Short note about team plans (per-agent keys, spend limits, audit trail)

paymentFailedPct.description: Share of attempts where the payment didn't go through
